PlainActionTarget.description:
A content mutation target or a non-mutating logical-view target.

The wire object always carries a camelCase `kind` discriminator so clients
can forward an offered target without inspecting its fields.

oneOf.description: Content-addressed target from a status tree.

mutationHash.description: Hash of the exact content the action is permitted to mutate.

selection.description:
Exact inclusive document rows selected in the offered render, when this
action represents a visual selection rather than a cursor action.

oneOf.description: Identity of the exact logical view that offered a semantic transition.

viewId.description: Logical view identity in the offering render.

oneOf.description: Exact node identity in the retained status view for visibility actions.

nodeId.description: Existing node identity in the offering tree.

viewId.description: Logical view identity in the offering render.

oneOf.description: Exact item identity in the retained structured menu.

menuId.description: Structured menu identity in the offering render.

viewId.description: Logical view identity in the offering render.

SelectionIntent.description: Normalized inclusive row coordinates retained as Plain selection input metadata.

endLine.description: Last selected row in the retained render.

startLine.description: First selected row in the retained render.

description: A Plain `workspace/executeCommand` action offered from a retained render.

documentUri.description: Open document URI the action was offered in.

target.description: Typed target from the offering render.

viewGeneration.description: Render generation the action was offered from.
